summary: Iter 82 broadcast + blocks: 19/19 backend tests pass. Broadcast dry_run correctly personalizes with parent first name, dedupes by phone (Ava/Jamie, Mia/Robin → 2 recipients), skips NoPhone Kid (no_phone_count=1), and appends links, music (🎵 with /api/public/media/<token>) and attachment (📎) trailers. Attachment upload + public HTML/raw endpoints work (no auth) and support HTTP Range (206). Blocks GET/PUT contract confirmed for payment/signup/paperwork/attendance including owner-only enforcement, non-member 404, and persist/clear round-trip via GET. Frontend smoke on mobile viewport passed: Roster → ⋯ menu → 'Message parents (text)' → /team/broadcast composer → 'Review & send' shows Confirm sheet with '2 parents will get a text', 'Hi Jamie, …' preview and masked phone (•••• 1111). Send-now NOT pressed (Twilio live).

minor.issue: Docstring/spec says 'links block' is appended, but backend uses core.sms.join_links which produces a single space-separated line (e.g. 'Waiver: https://... https://...'). Works but visually reads as one long line in the SMS body; consider newline-separated for readability.

issues: Photo attachment container renders empty (no visible upload spinner/hint) while ImagePicker permission dialog is pending on web — minor.
The 'Attach music' button is disabled when tracks.length===0 but the hint 'No music uploaded yet' is only shown inline; a dedicated empty-state row would be clearer.

react_native_issues.issue: Web preview logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Legacy warnings unrelated to iter 82 files but visible in this feature.

action_items: Blocks feature: the Manage-access UI (ManageAccessButton) intentionally renders null when the household has no other Team Hub members. Full end-to-end verification (blocked member gets the tracker filtered from GET /api/team/payments) requires a 2nd household member. Owner-side GET/PUT contract already verified with the owner's own user_id as the blocked_user_id and via /api/team/blocks/<resource>/<id> round-trip; the filter logic in team_payments.py (`docs = [d for d in docs if d['id'] not in blocked]`) is not tested against a real blocked *viewer* — needs a second Team Hub member to fully cover.
Consider newline-separating link entries in the SMS body for readability (currently join_links joins with a single space).

The applereview account has no payment_trackers/signup_sheets of its own (the seeded ones belong to another user_id), so end-to-end blocks-on-real-tracker could not be exercised against a live listing endpoint for this owner. Confirmed with data inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: broadcast.py send() correctly dedupes on the normalized parent phone before compose(); NoPhone rows are collected with the member's display name — good.

public/media/{token}/raw reads the entire file into memory before range slicing (data = await grid_out.read()); acceptable for ≤6 MB attachments but risky for large future audio. Consider streaming with `open_download_stream_by_name` + seek if track sizes grow.

blocks.py PUT relies on membership check against household.member_user_ids; a self-block by the owner is allowed by the schema. In practice UI filters out the owner via GET (excluded server-side), but PUT could still accept owner_id → owner shouldn't be able to block themself. Consider rejecting `blocked_user_id == owner_id`.

broadcast.py `_music_public_url` reuses an existing public_media doc by (kind=music, source_id) — good idempotency; note it will keep the first-generated token forever, which is fine for the current 'share' model.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded BC_TEST_* roster (Ava→Jamie 5550001111, Mia→Robin 5550002222, NoPhone Kid) and BCMUS_TEST_116a69 track. No sends were performed with dry_run=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For blocks: to fully verify hiding, invite a 2nd Team Hub member via /team-access (POST /api/team-access/invite), have them accept, then PUT /api/team/blocks?blocked=true with their user_id and confirm their GET /api/team/payments no longer includes that tracker. For broadcast SEND: NEVER call POST /api/team/broadcast/send with dry_run=false — Twilio is live and the seeded numbers (5550001111, 5550002222) normalize to valid E.164 US numbers.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all tested paths pass. Two failing tests during the run were caused by MY test assumptions (assumed the applereview account had payment_trackers/signups; it doesn't). Corrected tests use synthetic resource_ids and self-blocked user_id which is a valid path since the blocks endpoints don't validate resource_id existence.
